parts.zh: JetBlue航空公司一架从西棕榈滩飞往纽约市的航班周日上午在飞机撞鸟后被迫掉头降落
机上未报告有人员受伤
这种蛇是野外最致命、毒性最强的蛇类之一
市议会成员Anna Cumber在将电动自行车引入杰克逊维尔以为市中心注入新活力方面发挥了重要作用
M: 我们还给孩子零花钱
W: 我们也这样做,而且是按年龄支付
M: 教他们存钱很重要
W: 哦,我还没考虑过这样做
M: 时机成熟时,我会开始跟孩子们谈投资
W: 我一直跟大女儿强调存养老金的重要性
M: 是的,这是非常重要的一课

items.stem: What do we learn about the JetBlue Airlines flight from the news report?

choices.text: It hit a bird shortly after takeoff.
choices.zh: 起飞后不久撞上了一只鸟。

choices.text: Its crew members went on strike.
choices.zh: 机组人员举行了罢工。

choices.text: It narrowly escaped a plane crash when turning around.
choices.zh: 掉头时险些发生坠机事故。

choices.text: Its captain got slightly injured during the forced landing.
choices.zh: 机长在迫降过程中受了轻伤。

items.stem: How did the passengers feel when the plane came to a stop, according to Brian Healy?

choices.text: Panic.
choices.zh: 恐慌。

choices.text: Nervous.
choices.zh: 紧张。

choices.text: Relieved.
choices.zh: 如释重负。

choices.text: Contented.
choices.zh: 满意。

items.stem: What do we learn about the deadly snake from the news report?

choices.text: He is now kept in a secure area.
choices.zh: 它现在被关在一个安全区域。

choices.text: He has escaped the zoo once again.
choices.zh: 它再次从动物园逃脱了。

choices.text: He has been caught a second time.
choices.zh: 它已经第二次被抓住了。

choices.text: He finally disappeared six days ago.
choices.zh: 它最终在六天前消失了。

items.stem: How have the zoo staff been feeling about the snake?

choices.text: Squeezed.
choices.zh: 受挤压的。

choices.text: Threatened.
choices.zh: 受威胁的。

choices.text: Disappointed.
choices.zh: 失望的。

choices.text: Frustrated.
choices.zh: 沮丧的。

items.stem: What do we learn from the news report about the introduction of electric bikes into Jacksonville?

choices.text: It is condemned as a crazy idea.
choices.zh: 它被谴责为一个疯狂的想法。

choices.text: It is enriching the city's night life.
choices.zh: 它正在丰富这座城市的夜生活。

choices.text: It is questioned by local residents.
choices.zh: 它受到当地居民的质疑。

choices.text: It is giving rise to safety concerns.
choices.zh: 它正在引发安全担忧。

items.stem: What are electric bike riders supposed to do?

choices.text: Avoid entering one-way streets.
choices.zh: 避免进入单行道。

choices.text: Ensure the safety of pedestrians.
choices.zh: 确保行人的安全。

choices.text: Follow all the traffic rules drivers do.
choices.zh: 遵守驾驶员遵守的所有交通规则。

choices.text: Give way to automobiles at all times.
choices.zh: 任何时候都给机动车让行。

items.stem: Why did City Council member Anna Cumber advocate the introduction of electric bikes into Jacksonville?

choices.text: To ease the city's busy traffic.
choices.zh: 为了缓解城市的繁忙交通。

choices.text: To bring new life into the city.
choices.zh: 为了给城市带来新的活力。

choices.text: To add a new means of transport.
choices.zh: 为了增加一种新的交通方式。

choices.text: To reduce the city's air pollution.
choices.zh: 为了减少城市的空气污染。

items.stem: What should we do with the topic of money, according to the woman?

choices.text: Take it seriously.
choices.zh: 认真对待它。

choices.text: Discuss it regularly.
choices.zh: 定期讨论它。

choices.text: Make it sound scary.
choices.zh: 让它听起来很可怕。

choices.text: Talk about it openly.
choices.zh: 公开谈论它。

items.stem: How does the woman say money can be made real for children?

choices.text: By shopping around for the best deals.
choices.zh: 通过货比三家寻找最优惠的价格。

choices.text: By making abstract sums relevant.
choices.zh: 通过让抽象的金额变得相关。

choices.text: By citing concrete examples.
choices.zh: 通过引用具体的例子。

choices.text: By visiting discount stores.
choices.zh: 通过参观折扣商店。

items.stem: What is the common practice between the man and the woman?

choices.text: Paying their kids to help with housework.
choices.zh: 付钱给孩子们帮忙做家务。

choices.text: Setting kids a good example by sharing chores.
choices.zh: 通过分担家务给孩子们树立好榜样。

choices.text: Giving kids pocket money according to their needs.
choices.zh: 根据孩子们的需要给他们零花钱。

choices.text: Urging kids to deposit some of their gift money.
choices.zh: 督促孩子们存一些压岁钱。

items.stem: What is the woman always talking about to her elder daughter?

choices.text: The importance of cutting down family expenses.
choices.zh: 削减家庭开支的重要性。

choices.text: The need to learn important lessons from her elders.
choices.zh: 需要向长辈学习重要的经验教训。

choices.text: The delight in seeing their savings grow.
choices.zh: 看到他们的储蓄增长的喜悦。

choices.text: The necessity of saving into a pension.
choices.zh: 向养老金储蓄的必要性。

items.stem: What do we learn about the man?

choices.text: He is a successful businessman.
choices.zh: 他是一位成功的商人。

choices.text: He reviews books on political affairs.
choices.zh: 他评论政治事务方面的书籍。

choices.text: He has published a new bestseller.
choices.zh: 他出版了一本新的畅销书。

choices.text: He has worked in several banks.
choices.zh: 他曾在几家银行工作过。

items.stem: What does the woman say is the most controversial?

choices.text: The man's ideas about education.
choices.zh: 这位男士关于教育的观点。

choices.text: The man's academic background.
choices.zh: 这位男士的学术背景。

choices.text: The man's attempts at drawing public attention.
choices.zh: 这位男士吸引公众关注的尝试。

choices.text: The man's proposals to solve economic problems.
choices.zh: 这位男士解决经济问题的提案。

items.stem: What does the man say is his real goal?

choices.text: To reduce students' financial burden.
choices.zh: 减轻学生的经济负担。

choices.text: To motivate all students to be successful.
choices.zh: 激励所有学生取得成功。

choices.text: To give students incentive to excel in economics.
choices.zh: 给予学生在经济学方面出类拔萃的动力。

choices.text: To provide remedies for students' poor performance.
choices.zh: 为学生的不良表现提供补救措施。

items.stem: What will be one option for funding the proposed rewards according to the man?

choices.text: Improving school budgeting.
choices.zh: 改善学校预算。

choices.text: Increasing tuition fees.
choices.zh: 提高学费。

choices.text: Seeking donations.
choices.zh: 寻求捐赠。

choices.text: Raising taxes.
choices.zh: 提高税收。

items.stem: Why is the speaker launching a campaign?

choices.text: To show his sympathy towards people always being busy.
choices.zh: 表达他对总是忙碌的人们的同情。

choices.text: To prevent people from complaining about being "busy".
choices.zh: 阻止人们抱怨自己很"忙"。

choices.text: To call on busy people to take care of themselves.
choices.zh: 呼吁忙碌的人们照顾好自己。

choices.text: To help busy people to sort out their priorities.
choices.zh: 帮助忙碌的人们理清他们的优先事项。

items.stem: What does the speaker advise us to do next time someone asks how we are?

choices.text: Avoid saying we are busy.
choices.zh: 避免说我们很忙。

choices.text: Reflect on their true purpose.
choices.zh: 反思他们的真实目的。

choices.text: Describe our schedule in detail.
choices.zh: 详细描述我们的日程安排。

choices.text: Respond as most busy people do.
choices.zh: 像大多数忙碌的人那样回应。

items.stem: Why do many people make the "I'm busy" response according to the speaker?

choices.text: To show their achievements resulted from great efforts.
choices.zh: 展示他们通过巨大努力取得的成就。

choices.text: To prove they stand out as accomplished professionals.
choices.zh: 证明他们作为有成就的专业人士脱颖而出。

choices.text: To cover up their failure to achieve some purpose.
choices.zh: 掩盖他们未能实现某个目标的事实。

choices.text: To tell others a complete lie about their inability.
choices.zh: 向他人彻底撒谎说自己没有能力。

items.stem: What may sound strange to say about extreme sports?

choices.text: They will help one reduce fear
choices.zh: 它们会帮助人减少恐惧

choices.text: They should become so popular.
choices.zh: 它们应该变得如此流行。

choices.text: They will be less challenging after a time.
choices.zh: 一段时间后它们的挑战性会降低。

choices.text: They should cover so many different types.
choices.zh: 它们应该涵盖如此多不同的类型。

items.stem: Why should one be highly focused when doing extreme sports?

choices.text: To break one's ultimate limits.
choices.zh: 为了突破个人的极限

choices.text: To stop being extremely afraid.
choices.zh: 为了停止极度恐惧

choices.text: To avoid dangerous mistakes.
choices.zh: 为了避免危险的错误

choices.text: To enjoy the sports to the full.
choices.zh: 为了充分享受这些运动

items.stem: How can extreme sports benefit us more than standard exercise routines and sports?

choices.text: By allowing our motivation to be at an all-time high.
choices.zh: 通过让我们的动力达到空前的高度

choices.text: By stopping us hurting the same muscles repeatedly.
choices.zh: 通过阻止我们反复伤害相同的肌肉

choices.text: By burning as many as 300 calories per hour.
choices.zh: 通过每小时燃烧多达300卡路里

choices.text: By enabling us to get an all-over workout.
choices.zh: 通过使我们能够得到全身锻炼

items.stem: What does the passage say about conflict in organizations?

choices.text: It is natural.
choices.zh: 这是自然的。

choices.text: It is instrumental.
choices.zh: 这是有益的。

choices.text: It is personal.
choices.zh: 这是针对个人的。

choices.text: It is vital.
choices.zh: 这是至关重要的。

items.stem: Why do some people want to avoid conflict at all costs?

choices.text: To guard against being perceived negatively.
choices.zh: 防止被负面看待。

choices.text: To prevent themselves from being isolated.
choices.zh: 防止自己被孤立。

choices.text: To conceal personality preferences.
choices.zh: 隐藏个性偏好。

choices.text: To maintain workplace harmony.
choices.zh: 维护工作场所和谐。

items.stem: Why is productive conflict important for teams and organizations?

choices.text: It helps to enhance team spirit.
choices.zh: 它有助于增强团队精神。

choices.text: It stimulates innovative ideas.
choices.zh: 它激发创新想法。

choices.text: It helps to resolve problems.
choices.zh: 它有助于解决问题。

choices.text: It facilitates policy-making.
choices.zh: 它促进政策制定。

items.stem: What does productive conflict need as a basis?

choices.text: An innovative mind.
choices.zh: 创新思维。

choices.text: Corporate culture.
choices.zh: 企业文化。

choices.text: Mutual trust.
choices.zh: 相互信任。

choices.text: A healthy mentality.
choices.zh: 健康的心态。
